name: French Toast Latte
caffeineNote: Label states 200 mg; brand notes contents may vary
summary: French-toast-flavored latte on reduced-fat milk, one of the stronger cans we track at a label-printed 200 mg of caffeine per 11 oz can, with 16 g of sugar (only 5 g of it added, alongside sucralose) and 7 g of protein at 140 calories.
